name: bis-sahayak
description: BIS Sahayak — AI-powered Intelligent Assistant for Indian Standards and BIS Services (SIH26107)

scripts.setup: npm install && python -m pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt
scripts.db:seed: python ingestion/seed_standards.py && python ingestion/seed_qco.py && python ingestion/seed_verification.py
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ai,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm --prefix node-api test && npm --prefix frontend test && python -m pytest ai-service/tests -q
